36518.en: X_36518 is the complement of X_15055.
no: See Kadir Altintas and César Lozada, `Euclid 549 <https://groups.io/g/euclid/message/549>`__.

Let O_{A} be the circle centered at A and tangent to the Euler line. Define O_{B} and O_{C} cyclically. Let L_{A} be the polar of X_4 wrt O_{A}, and define L_{B} and L_{C} cyclically. (Note: X_4 is the perspector of every circle centered at a vertex of ABC.) Let A' = L_{B} ∩ L_{C}, and define B' and C' cyclically. A'B'C' is the reflection of ABC in X_5972 (the radical center of O_{A}, O_{B}, O_{C}), and is homothetic to the Euler triangle at X_36518. (Randy Hutson, March 29, 2020)
